text: Post claims the city marathon was canceled today due to snow.
evidence_text: City sports office announced the marathon proceeds on Sunday.
Weather bulletin shows clear conditions downtown this morning.

text: Photo says a tiger was seen inside a suburban grocery store.
evidence_text: Local police report confirms no wildlife incidents at the store.
Store security camera stills show normal customer traffic only.

text: Breaking: the mayor resigned after budget fraud investigation.
evidence_text: City hall statement says the mayor remains in office.
No resignation filing appears in council records.

text: Caption claims this crowd image is from last night's protest in Boston.
evidence_text: Reverse image search matches a 2019 concert in Chicago.
Police log lists no protest permit at the cited Boston site last night.

text: Graphic states gas prices dropped to $1.20 statewide this week.
evidence_text: State energy dashboard shows average price above $3.00.
Station boards in the image do not display the claimed value.

text: Article says a new bridge opened today connecting Eastport and Milltown.
evidence_text: Transport agency press release confirms inauguration this morning.
Route maps show the bridge directly links Eastport and Milltown.

text: Viral post says the stadium roof collapsed during the final match.
evidence_text: League footage shows the final completed without structural incident.
Frame-level analysis indicates compositing artifacts around the roofline.

text: Local report: elementary school reopened after water leak repairs.
evidence_text: District notice confirms classes resumed Monday morning.
Parent updates show students entering the campus today.

text: Claim: this image shows snowfall in Miami in July.
evidence_text: Meteorological records show no snowfall event in Miami in July.
Palm-tree shadows in the image are inconsistent with active snowfall.

text: Post says the singer announced a charity tour for flood victims.
evidence_text: Official verified account posted the same tour announcement.
Event listing names the charity partner cited in the post.

text: Screenshot claims the central bank cut rates by 3% overnight.
evidence_text: Central bank bulletin reports no emergency rate decision.
The screenshot timestamp formatting differs from the official app style.

text: Residents share that the river cleanup removed 12 tons of waste.
evidence_text: Municipal report records 11.8 tons removed during the cleanup week.
Photo metadata aligns with the listed river district.

text: Thread says the airport is fully closed after a runway fire.
evidence_text: Airport operations page lists normal departures with minor delays.
Fire service log shows a small vehicle incident outside the runway zone.

text: Photo caption states this is yesterday's eclipse over Denver.
evidence_text: Astronomy calendar shows no solar eclipse visible from Denver yesterday.
Skyline comparison matches a stock image from another city.

text: Community page reports free vaccine clinic opened at West Hall.
evidence_text: County health website lists West Hall as today's clinic venue.
Poster text in the image matches the county hotline number.

text: Claim says a shark was found in a downtown fountain.
evidence_text: City wildlife office denies any such recovery incident.
Image edges around the animal show inconsistent lighting and blending.

text: Report says commuter rail service resumes tonight after strike talks.
evidence_text: Transit authority bulletin confirms trains restart at 8 PM.
Union and operator jointly announced a temporary agreement.

text: Headline claims the actor endorsed candidate Green at a rally.
evidence_text: Campaign office says no endorsement statement was issued.
The rally photo predates the current election cycle.

text: Neighborhood alert says a sinkhole closed Pine Street this morning.
evidence_text: Public works notice confirms Pine Street closure from 9 AM.
Traffic cameras show barricades at both entrances to the block.

text: Shared image claims voting was extended by two days nationwide.
evidence_text: Election commission states voting dates remain unchanged.
Notice in the graphic uses an unofficial seal and wrong hotline number.
